notes.title: Patch s1.0.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Hello,

TimeToDie has been updated with some minor gameplay changes and bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally made items ungrabbable.
[*]Fixed an issue that made the game crash occasionally
[*]Fixed hand UI to correctly display remaining play time.
[*]Fixed an issue that made mobs were running through the player.
[/list]
